node.title: Re: "indir" in shebang line
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: Much of the text in that perldoc is so old now that it is pretty much out-of-date. Perl is no different from any other language that a shell can invoke to handle a "console command," and the rules for doing so depend on the shell in question, not Perl. This perldoc should probably be updated by someone to reflect the 21st century.
